scope: Standing Kunsthistorisches Museum on Maria-Theresien-Platz, with its two courtyards, principal Renaissance Revival facades, paired small cupolas, copper dome and Pallas Athena finial.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Property owner confirms the art museum opened in 1891, designed by Semper and Hasenauer, with multiple allegorical and historical sculptures and Pallas Athena crowning the dome lantern.
Vienna describes the matching Ringstrasse twin museums with distinct rooftop figures.
The matching Natural History Museum records about 60 m for its dome. This supplies an approximate envelope for the art museum dome from the matching architectural composition.
Museum owner documents the monumental structure and its construction dates of 1871–1891.
